name: Futari no Erika ~Osananajimi to Imakano to~
original_name: ふたりのえりか～幼なじみと今彼女と～
source:
Kentaro had an old friend, Erika. She used to live next to his house, but her family went abroad on business. Just before she left, they promised to meet again and marry. A few years later, he is now a university student. He lives alone and has a girlfriend. Her name is also Erika. He enjoys his university life with her. But one day, a girl suddenly cuts in. Yes, it is his old friend, Erika. Their battle for Kentaro now begins....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090107031946/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009487]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
健太郎儿时曾有一位名叫“绘里香”的青梅竹马住在隔壁，后来随父母出国公干而远赴海外；临别前夕，两小无猜的两人许下了日后重逢成婚的约定。转眼数年过去，升入大学独自生活的健太郎身边已有了一位正在交往的女友——巧合的是，现任女友的名字同样念作“绘里香”。正当健太郎与女友享受着甜蜜的大学时光之际，一名少女突如其来地闯入了两人之间——没错，她正是当年许下婚约的青梅竹马绘里香！两位“绘里香”围绕健太郎展开的修罗场争夺战，就此打响……
